question: Does more of the floating share base changing hands between the final VCP supply peak and breakout indicate that overhead supply was absorbed?

causal_input.availability: The latest positive float_shares record with effective_date not later than each market date; no latest-instrument fallback when history exists.
causal_input.units: Daily volume is round lots and float_shares is shares, so volume * 100 / float_shares is the fraction of the float traded that day.

feature.cumulative_float_turnover: Sum daily traded-share fraction from the recorded final pivot date through the completed trading day before the breakout signal. The breakout bar and all future bars are excluded.

method: Compare the continuous feature overall, by candidate year, and in annual-within-year quintiles. No cutoff, alternate window, score, strategy rule or portfolio backtest is evaluated.
stop_rule: All four gates must pass. Otherwise stop cumulative-turnover filtering and ranking without trying per-day turnover, alternate pivot windows, absolute turnover cutoffs or weighted combinations.
next_if_pass: Freeze descending cumulative-turnover ranking as the only new v3 intervention and run one fixed time-split diagnostic against forward-v2.
next_if_fail: Keep turnover as descriptive evidence only and move to a different VCP mechanism.
